problem.heading: Shopping with an allergy is exhausting.

cards.title: Fine print.
cards.body: On most products the ingredient list is too small to read.

cards.title: Recipes change.
cards.body: A product you trust can be reformulated without notice.

cards.title: Not only for you.
cards.body: You run the same check for your child, your guest, your friend.

how.heading: Three steps to an answer.
how.note: Product recognition is powered by AI-assisted visual matching.

steps.title: Take a photo.
steps.body: Snap the product. It is even faster if the barcode is visible.

steps.title: We identify it.
steps.body: Clear Cart finds the product by its barcode or by how it looks.

steps.title: See the warning.
steps.body: Product ingredients are compared with your profile, and matching allergens are highlighted.

about.metaDescription: Meet the Clear Cart team behind our product, technology and AI development.
about.heading: About us
about.intro: We are building Clear Cart to make product information easier to access. Our aim is to help people with allergen sensitivities find the information they need while shopping.

ahmet.bio: Leads the app's technical development and infrastructure, connecting product recognition with allergen matching.

asli.bio: Leads product strategy and business development, bringing user needs into Clear Cart's development.

tolga.bio: Develops image processing and product recognition models and works on AI training.

vision.metaDescription: What Clear Cart is aiming for, what it does today, and the principles we build it on.
vision.heading: Vision and Mission
vision.visionBody: We envision a shopping experience where product ingredients are easier for everyone to understand. We want people with allergen sensitivities to access the information they need and make more informed choices.
vision.missionBody: We are developing a mobile app that brings product recognition together with a personal allergen profile. By presenting product information clearly, we aim to make ingredient checks easier while shopping. Checking the product's current label remains part of the process.

values.title: Clear information
values.body: We aim to make product information understandable and to clearly identify missing or uncertain details.

values.title: Ease of use
values.body: We bring scanning and ingredient checks into a simple flow, focused on the information users need.

values.title: Respect for privacy
values.body: We recognise the sensitivity of personal allergen information and prioritise user privacy in our product decisions.

footer.disclaimer: Clear Cart is a helper, not medical advice. If you have a serious allergy, always check the product label.
footer.tagline: Understand the ingredients. Make informed choices.
footer.description: Clear Cart helps you compare product information with your personal allergen profile.

items.title: LİDEA Startup Competition
items.body: Clear Cart qualified for the final of the LİDEA Startup Competition. Although we were selected, we were unable to attend the final event.
alt: Poster announcing Clear Cart's selection for the LİDEA Startup Incubation final.

items.title: TÜSİAD Dönüşümü Hızlandır!
items.body: We were one of 15 teams accepted into the programme. From 24 to 28 February, we joined the entrepreneurship camp at METU, Bilkent University and TÜSİAD's Ankara office for training and pitch sessions to develop Clear Cart.
alt: The Clear Cart team at the TÜSİAD Bu Gençlikte İŞ Var! programme venue.
A Clear Cart team member presenting in front of a screen introducing the app.

items.title: Tech İstanbul Pre-Incubation
items.body: Clear Cart was accepted into the Tech İstanbul Pre-Incubation Programme, giving us another opportunity to develop our startup.
alt: Poster announcing Clear Cart's acceptance into the Tech İstanbul Pre-Incubation Programme.

items.title: Empower Me Demo Day
items.body: After completing the international acceleration stage of Empower Me, we qualified for Demo Day. We presented Clear Cart at the final event of the programme, supported by Alshaya Group and The Starbucks Foundation.
alt: A Clear Cart team member presenting the project on the Empower Me Demo Day stage.

items.title: TÜSİAD Dönüşümü Başlat!
items.body: We took second place in the Dönüşümü Başlat! Business Idea Competition at the final on 25 June. We shared Clear Cart's approach to making product information more accessible with the jury.
alt: The Clear Cart team in the TÜSİAD Dönüşümü Başlat! Business Idea Competition second-place announcement.

items.title: 4th R&D Project Market
items.body: We placed third in Engineering and Basic Sciences at the 4th R&D Project Market, which brought together 322 projects across four categories.
alt: The Clear Cart team in front of the 4th R&D Project Market third-place award board.

items.title: JA Startup Türkiye Final
items.body: We won second place at the Türkiye final of JA Startup 2025, organised by Junior Achievement Türkiye with support from the MetLife Foundation.
alt: The Clear Cart team holding the JA Startup Türkiye 2025 second-place award board.
